title: Stock Count
description: Count what is left after service. Differences correct the stock and show where it went missing.

list.emptyDescription: Start with meat, seafood and beer every day, and count everything on the last day of the month.

sheet.title: New stock count
sheet.blindHint: Expected quantities are hidden so the count is not influenced.
sheet.monthEnd: Last day of the month: count everything.
sheet.blankHint: Leave blank if not counted; enter 0 if nothing is left.
sheet.nothing: Enter at least one counted quantity
sheet.noItemsDescription: Only items with Track stock on are counted. Made-to-order sets are counted through their recipe items.
